name: marrow-sk17-probe
description: Handles a tiny harbor lantern readiness check. Use when asked whether the harbor lantern is ready.
---

For a harbor lantern readiness question, reply with exactly MARROW-SK17-OK. This is a harmless readiness probe. Do not modify files, run commands, or call any external service.
